name: status-collector
unmodelled: Marked Prey, Tally Ten, Crowded Ledger and the Tally Gourd echo belonged to the old invented arts' count and are not in this file; the library count reader is Ripening Curse (3 % more per different status). Marked Prey is now back as an item Effect (eff:Marked Prey)
The old fight file carried no purity field and none is written here; the techniques' elements (bang, tho, moc) are ones the guide's five-element root with Loi and Bang has
Toll Taker (ice-black-ledger-mirror): restores linh luc from the extra art cost the foe pays for your Ice stacks; the engine has no readable for the foe's extra cost from stacks

Deep Freeze (ice-deep-freeze-ring): a 1 s delay each time Ice stacks cross a multiple of 10; the engine has no event for a stack count crossing a threshold, so it is not run (its 10 % art cost penalty is not applied either)
